game_concept: A card battler set in Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing, a moonlit clearing: the druid must handle bramble beasts while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Moonlit Clearing: a moonlit clearing
core_gameplay_loop: In Moonlit Clearing, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about picks_right to power up the druid and open the waterfall gate.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Loop Picker
